_README: The default meta fixture reproduces TODAY'S REALITY: the ingestion pipeline's decklist import is paused and mtg_v1 publishes no tournament views, so the meta repository is unavailable. Tests that need the populated world load meta_populated.json instead. Having the absent case be the default is deliberate — it is the case that ships.
detail: the ingestion pipeline has not published the tournament half of the mtg_v1 contract yet (its Stage 3 is paused)
